verified_context: Desired outcome: Then source declares secondary controls once; the shared UI places a small card corner trigger, reveals Archive, and asks for confirmation before the canonical mutation.
Verified code: actions rejects content suites and supports ordinary operation expressions; menu accepts only route descriptors; dropdown has neither source decoding nor activated-button semantics.

Generated view contracts pass immutable pre-rendered control bindings, including actions. Their allowed children exclude structural groups. Delete currently emits its canonical confirmation inline, so every option needs a compact opener for that existing form.

alternatives.A: Add the previously invalid suite shape to actions with overflow as the default for that shape. Reuse canonical control rendering and preserve expression-based actions unchanged.
alternatives.B: Add a purpose-specific action_menu suite, reuse canonical controls and provide the corner trigger, entries and confirmation defaults under the new name.
alternatives.C: Make existing dropdown slots compile and compose explicit trigger/content at every callsite, using canonical control confirmation openers. Retain explicit layout responsibilities in source.
